name: buwan-premiere
description: Connects Claude Code to Adobe Premiere Pro (premiere-pro-mcp 1.11.5 + MCP Bridge panel) and applies the Buwan engine's decisions inside the open project: studio bins and label colors, cull, flagged b-roll, dead-air subclips, the empty SDE assembly sequence, A-Roll clean, multicam SYNC sequences, the music-driven SDE Cut, studio LUT, dialogue levels.
